summary.text: Brian Hill (R) has served Oklahoma House District 47, which covers Mustang, Oklahoma City, and Tuttle, since 2018. He is an Oversight Committee Chair in the 60th Legislature.

paragraphs.text: His House biography describes him as a businessman, public speaker, former youth pastor, author, and entrepreneur who serves on the boards of several local non-profit organizations.
He is married to his college sweetheart, whom he met at Southwestern Christian University in Bethany, and the family lives on a small farm in Mustang.
